summary: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region. Before this change it returned 0 tax for an unknown region.

findings.title: None return breaks both tax_for callers
findings.problem: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region. order_total in checkout.py:6 adds that result to an int, and tax_line in receipt.py:6 divides it by 100.
findings.consequence: Checkout raises TypeError for any order from a region outside RATES. Printing that order's receipt also raises TypeError, so those customers cannot complete a purchase.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for an unknown region. Otherwise, update order_total and tax_line to handle None before this change ships.

findings.title: Changed unknown-region behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: The repository has no test files. No test exercises the new unknown-region branch of tax_for.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the TypeError in order_total and tax_line before the push.
findings.fix: Add tests that call tax_for, order_total and tax_line with a known region and with an unknown region.
